d: Run the day-to-day Toyota win-back, voice of customer (VOC), and campaign operations within CX Systems, the customer experience and retention function for Toyota & Lexus Aftersales in Manama, Bahrain. Work closely with CRM/ERP, Marketing, Operations, and the Call Centre to improve customer retention and coordinate customer feedback resolution. Support the transition from hand-curated Pilot Batch data and manual SMS, Call, and App push activities to a governed Data pipeline and automated customer journeys.

Win-Back Operations: Generate and manage the weekly Toyota win-back outreach list using the Pilot Batch initially, transitioning to the full Data pipeline. Brief the Call Centre on scripts and offers, and track outcomes through bookings, visits, and revenue.

Campaign Planning and Quality Assurance: Draft and quality-check each Toyota campaign brief, including audience, offer, suppression rules, and tracking requirements, before submission to CRM/ERP and Marketing for execution.

Voice of Customer Management: Manage daily VOC triage: classify feedback, assign cases, track resolution against agreed service-level agreements (SLAs), and immediately escalate safety-critical issues.
Data Analysis and Reporting: Produce the weekly management insight pack covering retention KPIs, campaign performance, and VOC themes.

Campaign Channels and Lifecycle Management: Run the Toyota campaign channel mix and lifecycle calendar across SMS, Call, and App push. Expand to automated WhatsApp journeys and maintain an experiment log with results and next steps.
Communication and Collaboration: Coordinate weekly with service centre leads and the Call Centre to align customer-facing teams on live initiatives and operational requirements.

Process Improvement and Automation: Support the development of a governed, automated retention system through hand-curated data preparation, manual quality assurance, phased rollouts, Data validation, and campaign automation as capabilities become available.
All other Job-Related duties as assigned
